0.original: Urianger is eager to rejoin Y'shtola.

24.original: Speak with Y'shtola at the Drowning Brand.

49.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We can begin as soon as the others arrive.

50.original: Some manner of cactuar attempted to make mischief, but no one came to harm. How did you fare?

51.original: With Estinien keeping us safe, we were able to finish repairing the brands without incident!

52.original: <hex:024804F2022303>What aid I lend in restoring the brands is insignificant next to that which you and yours must accomplish.<hex:0248020103>

53.original: <hex:024804F2022303>When my part is complete, I shall stand apart and observe, as I have ever done. For it was to you that Venat has entrusted the future.<hex:0248020103>

54.original: The brands are ready, I presume? Excellent. With the Loporrits having deployed their supporters, we are ready to proceed.

55.original: Let us rejoin Y'shtola posthaste, and prise open our gate unto the void.

57.original: I have duly informed Y'shtola of our task's completion.

58.original: While you all tend to matters in the Thirteenth, I shall remain here and ensure the integrity of gate and seal both.

59.original: My thanks for seeing to the supporters. With this, all is in readiness for the ritual.

60.original: First, I shall give the order to Alphinaud and Alisaie in the Tower of Babil to channel aether to the moon.

61.original: Once we have amassed a sufficient amount of energy, Urianger and I shall begin our incantations to open a voidgate.

62.original: If all goes well, a tear will form in the fabric of reality, at which point you must activate the brands and put in place the containment seal.

63.original: That is all. If there are no questions, then let us begin!

65.original: Zero appears to be lost in thought, her gaze fixed upon the fathomless abyss...

66.original: My lance will be ready should any more of Golbez's pawns appear.

67.original: No sign of a watcher or any Loporrits. Perhaps they were swallowed up in the Flood of Darkness...or perhaps they never existed here.

68.original: The surface of the moon is a grim shade of crimson. A consequence of the Flood of Darkness perhaps.

69.original: No matter how you strain your eyes, you spy no signs of life. In all directions extends a desolate waste without end.

70.original: You hold your breath in an attempt to catch the faintest noise. Save for the sounds of your comrades, there is nothing.

71.original: So far, you have failed to find any clues as to Azdaja's whereabouts. Perhaps Zero has noticed something you missed...
